details.description: InternVL3-8B is a multimodal vision-language model from OpenGVLab (Shanghai AI Laboratory) that pairs an InternViT-300M-448px-V2.5 vision encoder with a Qwen2.5-7B language model in a ViT-MLP-LLM design, natively built for image, video and text understanding. This catalog entry serves it as a text chat model with a 16,384-token context window. OpenGVLab's InternVL project repository lists InternVL3.5 (released August 2025) as the current generation superseding the InternVL3 series.
advantages: Combines an InternViT-300M-448px-V2.5 vision encoder with a Qwen2.5-7B language backbone in a ViT-MLP-LLM architecture, per OpenGVLab.
Weights are published in BF16 precision on Hugging Face and ModelScope under the Apache 2.0 license (via its Qwen2.5-7B base).
disadvantages: This catalog entry exposes only text input and output, even though InternVL3-8B is natively a vision-language model.
Superseded within OpenGVLab's own family by the newer InternVL3.5 series (August 2025), which the maker says improves versatility, reasoning and inference efficiency.

notes: Catalog facts list modality as text_input/text_output only, but the model card describes InternVL3-8B as natively multimodal (vision + text); kept the catalog's text-only modality as authoritative and reflected that as a limitation instead of listing vision use cases. Benchmark numbers on the model card are shown only as chart images, not machine-readable figures, so no evaluations are listed.
